说明: 摄影机预设（成像逻辑，4.0 alpha.14）：机身决定宽容度和色彩科学，镜头组决定焦外、耀光和锐度，胶片决定颗粒和高光，补充效果是看得见的后果。设定.json 的 film_look.camera 选全片一组；worlds.<世界>.camera 给某个世界换一组；镜头的 camera 单独换一镜。en 进视频提示词；stills_en 进场景图（出图模型会把颗粒照字面画成噪点，默认不带颗粒，试拍验证后再放开）。C01–C04 来自用户 2026-11-09。

预设.name: 胶片质感
预设.effects_zh: 细腻胶片颗粒，柔和亮部，保留皮肤纹理
预设.effects_en: fine film grain, soft highlight roll-off, natural skin texture retained
预设.stills_en: soft highlight roll-off, natural skin texture retained, gentle film tonality
预设.best_for: 剧情、年代、人物戏、温暖或忧郁的室内与黄昏

预设.name: 自然清晰的人物画面
预设.lens_zh: 蔡司 Supreme Prime 球面
预设.effects_zh: 自然肤色，眼睛清晰对焦，背景柔和虚化
预设.effects_en: natural skin tones, eyes in crisp focus, softly blurred background
预设.stills_en: natural skin tones, eyes in crisp focus, softly blurred background
预设.best_for: 现代都市、对话戏、广告、需要干净的人像

预设.name: 夜景与霓虹
预设.lens_zh: Laowa Proteus 2 倍变形（蓝耀光）
预设.effects_zh: 强点光源附近出现蓝色横向耀光，远处灯点呈竖向椭圆，人物比例自然
预设.effects_en: blue horizontal flares near strong point lights, distant lights rendered as vertical oval bokeh, natural human proportions
预设.stills_en: blue horizontal flares near strong point lights, distant lights rendered as vertical oval bokeh, natural human proportions
预设.best_for: 夜景、霓虹街道、科幻都市、赛车夜戏

预设.name: 灯串下的人像近景
预设.effects_zh: 眼睛清晰，背景灯点柔和偏圆，不刻意添加变形镜头式横向光带
预设.effects_en: sharp eyes, soft round background light bokeh, no anamorphic-style horizontal streaks
预设.stills_en: sharp eyes, soft round background light bokeh, no anamorphic-style horizontal streaks
预设.best_for: 夜间人像近景、灯串、烛光、温柔的情感戏

预设.name: 宽银幕史诗
预设.effects_zh: 宽画面里有巨大的空间感，焦外椭圆，高光柔和滚降，强光处有克制的横向光条，暗部细节丰富
预设.effects_en: vast sense of scale in a wide frame, oval bokeh, smooth highlight roll-off, restrained horizontal streaks on strong lights, rich shadow detail
预设.stills_en: vast sense of scale in a wide frame, oval bokeh, smooth highlight roll-off, restrained horizontal streaks on strong lights, rich shadow detail
预设.best_for: 史诗、巨物、怪兽、大场面、神话

预设.name: 暗调变形恐怖
预设.effects_zh: 深而干净的黑位，脸从阴影里被一道硬光刻出来，焦外椭圆带轻微边缘畸变，暗部有细颗粒，高光克制
预设.effects_en: deep clean blacks, faces carved out of shadow by a single hard light, oval bokeh with slight edge distortion, fine grain in the shadows, restrained highlights
预设.stills_en: deep clean blacks, faces carved out of shadow by a single hard light, oval bokeh with slight edge distortion, restrained highlights
预设.best_for: 恐怖、悬疑、民俗恐怖、宿命感

预设.name: 16 毫米手持纪实
预设.effects_zh: 明显的 16 毫米颗粒，轻微暗角，高光略溢出，色彩偏暖偏旧，手持的呼吸感
预设.effects_en: visible 16mm grain, slight vignette, highlights gently blooming, warm faded color, handheld breathing
预设.stills_en: slight vignette, highlights gently blooming, warm faded color
预设.best_for: 纪实、回忆、青春、伪纪录片

预设.name: 年代胶片日景
预设.effects_zh: 老式变形镜头的柔和边缘，暖调日光，细颗粒，高光带一点光晕，色彩饱满但不艳
预设.effects_en: soft edges of vintage anamorphic glass, warm daylight, fine grain, slight halation on highlights, rich but not garish color
预设.stills_en: soft edges of vintage anamorphic glass, warm daylight, slight halation on highlights, rich but not garish color
预设.best_for: 年代、西部、公路、民俗日景
